newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RANGERS CRUISE TO NINTH SUCCESSIVE TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RANGERS CRUISE TO NINTH SUCCESSIVE TITLE.

text.p: A goal by Denmark's Brian Laudrup gave Glasgow Rangers a 1-0 win at Dundee United on Wednesday and duly secured their ninth successive Scottish league championship.
All but assured of the title before the match, Rangers could start celebrating when Laudrup headed his 20th goal of the season after 11 minutes at Tannadice.
Paul Gascoigne hit a post and Charlie Miller scraped the bar as Rangers dominated against the side third in the table.
Celtic, who had a slight mathematical chance of catching the leaders before Wednesday's games, could only draw 0-0 at Kilmarnock in the night's other premier division match.
Rangers' title, their 48th since the league began in 1890/91, equalled the nine in a row achieved by their great rivals Celtic from 1966 to 1974.
Rangers had hoped to settle the issue in front of their own fans last Saturday but surprisingly lost 2-0 to Motherwell.
With one game remaining, Rangers have 80 points to the 72 of Celtic. Dundee United are third on 60.
